doc.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013

title: Closing remarks
summary: Thanks and goodbyes, with a joke about the Mark Murphy room.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well it’s been my pleasure. We’re about to run out of speed here, so.
It was very interesting for me.
I’m glad we got to meet. Keep doing what you’re doing.
Well come on by again and we’ll let you stay in the Mark Murphy room.
You won’t turn gay, believe me.
